title: Molecular hybridization design and synthesis of novel spirooxindole-based MDM2 inhibitors endowed with BCL2 signaling attenuation; a step towards the next generation p53 activators.
authors: Lotfy, Gehad; Abdel Aziz, Yasmine M; Said, Mohamed M; El Ashry, El Sayed H; El Tamany, El Sayed H; Abu-Serie, Marwa M; Teleb, Mohamed; Domling, Alexander; Barakat, Assem
one_liner_zh: 该文为MDM2小分子抑制剂的设计合成与活性评价，属于蛋白-蛋白相互作用药物化学研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Despite the achieved progress in developing efficient MDM2-p53 protein-protein interaction inhibitors (MDM2 inhibitors), the acquired resistance of tumor cells to such p53 activators posed an argument about the druggability of the pathway. Combination studies disclosed that concomitant inhibition of MDM2 and BCL2 functions can sensitize the tumor cells and synergistically induce apoptosis. Herein, we employed a rapid combinatorial approach to generate a novel series of hybrid spirooxindole-based MDM2 inhibitors (5a-s) endowed with BCL2 signaling attenuation. The adducts were designed to mimic the thematic features of the chemically stable potent spiro[3H-indole-3,2'-pyrrolidin]-2(1H)-ones MDM2 inhibitors while installing a pyrrole ring on the core via a carbonyl spacer inspired by the natural product marinopyrrole A that efficiently inhibits BCL2 family functions by various mechanisms. NCI 60 cell-line panel screening revealed their promising broad-spectrum antiproliferative activities. The NCI-selected derivatives were screened for cytotoxic activities against normal fibroblasts, MDA-MB 231, HepG-2, and Caco-2 cells via MTT assay, subjected to mechanistic apoptosis studies for assessment of p53, BCL2, p21, and caspase 3/7 status, then evaluated for potential MDM2 inhibition utilizing MST assay. The most balanced potent and safe derivatives; 5i and 5q were more active than 5-fluorouracil, exhibited low mumrange MDM2 binding (K(D)=1.32and 1.72 mum, respectively), induced apoptosis-dependent anticancer activities up to 50%, activated p53 by 47-63%, downregulated the BCL2 gene to 59.8%, and reduced its protein level (13.75%) in the treated cancer cells. Further downstream p53 signaling studies revealed > 2 folds p21 upregulation and > 3 folds caspase 3/7 activation. Docking simulations displayed that the active MDM2 inhibitors resided well into the p53 binding sites of MDM2, and shared key interactions with the co-crystalized inhibitor posed by the indolinone scaffold (5i, 5p, and 5q), the halogen substituents (5r), or the installed spiro ring (5s). Finally, in silico ADMET profiling predicted acceptable drug-like properties with full accordance to Lipinski's, Veber's, and Muegge's bioavailability parameters for 5i and a single violation for 5q.
abstract_zh: 尽管在开发高效的MDM2-p53蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂（MDM2抑制剂）方面取得了进展，但肿瘤细胞对此类p53激活剂的获得性耐药性对该通路的可成药性提出了质疑。联合研究显示，同时抑制MDM2和BCL2功能可使肿瘤细胞敏感化并协同诱导凋亡。在此，我们采用快速组合方法生成了一系列新型杂合螺吲哚酮类MDM2抑制剂（5a-s），并赋予其BCL2信号衰减功能。这些加合物被设计为模拟化学稳定且强效的螺[3H-吲哚-3,2'-吡咯烷]-2(1H)-酮类MDM2抑制剂的主题特征，同时通过羰基间隔基在核心上安装吡咯环，该设计灵感来源于天然产物marinopyrrole A，后者通过多种机制有效抑制BCL2家族功能。NCI 60细胞系筛选显示其具有广谱抗增殖活性。NCI选定的衍生物通过MTT法评估了对正常成纤维细胞、MDA-MB 231、HepG-2和Caco-2细胞的细胞毒性活性，进行了机制性凋亡研究以评估p53、BCL2、p21和caspase 3/7状态，随后利用MST法评估了潜在的MDM2抑制作用。最具平衡性、强效且安全的衍生物5i和5q比5-氟尿嘧啶更具活性，表现出低微摩尔范围的MDM2结合（K(D)分别为1.32和1.72微摩尔），诱导了高达50%的凋亡依赖性抗癌活性，将p53激活47-63%，下调BCL2基因至59.8%，并在处理过的癌细胞中将其蛋白水平降低至13.75%。进一步的下游p53信号研究显示p21上调超过2倍，caspase 3/7激活超过3倍。对接模拟显示，活性MDM2抑制剂良好地嵌入MDM2的p53结合位点，并与共结晶抑制剂共享关键相互作用，这些作用由吲哚酮骨架（5i、5p和5q）、卤素取代基（5r）或安装的螺环（5s）介导。最后，计算机ADMET分析预测了可接受的药物样性质，5i完全符合Lipinski、Veber和Muegge的生物利用度参数，而5q仅有一个违规项。
